guide-entry-211c43481b97cfd6abe14234.description: Report of the International Law Commission on the work of its twenty-sixth session , 6 May to 26 July 1974 Re-examined the draft articles in light of the comments submitted by Governments. On the basis of the first report of the Special Rapporteur , Sir Francis Vallat, the Commission adopted the final text of the draft articles on succession of States in respect of treaties as a whole, with commentaries, and submitted it to the General Assembly with a recommendation that the Assembly invite Member States to submit their written comments and observations on the draft articles. It also recommended that the Assembly convene a conference of plenipotentiaries to study the draft articles and conclude a convention on the subject. Discussion in Plenary : 1264th meeting (24 May 1974), 1266th , 1267th , 1268th , 1269th , 1270th , 1271st , 1272nd , and 1273rd meetings (28 May to 7 June 1974), 1279th , 1280th , 1281st , 1282nd , 1283rd , 1284th , 1285th , 1286th , 1287th , 1288th , 1289th and 1290th meetings (17 June to 5 July 1974), and 1293rd , 1294th , 1295th and 1296th meetings (12 to 18 July 1974) ILC Report, A/9610/Rev.1 (A/29/10), 1974, chap.
